_comment: Ricoh GR-style pack (docs/LIBRARY_V1.md, section "Ricoh-style pack"): 5 colour looks, recipes in sim/recipes/ricoh_like.json. Not part of the 32-look library. E-M1 II card (canonical 16 + these 5): patches/omdem1mk2/sd_loader/make_looks_bin.py --extra bundles/ricoh_gr.json --out <dir>. These 5 alone: tools/ep7_looks_bin.py bundles/ricoh_gr.json --out <dir>. Own designs after Ricoh's Image Control names; no Ricoh data used.

ricoh_positive.name: Pos. Film
ricoh_positive.notes: Ricoh-style Positive Film: rich slide colour, teal skies, crimson reds, olive greens, firm contrast.

ricoh_negative.name: Neg. Film
ricoh_negative.notes: Ricoh-style Negative Film: soft, faded, muted colour, teal greens, cyan-leaning skies, lifted blacks.

ricoh_retro.name: Retro
ricoh_retro.notes: Ricoh-style Retro: warm, yellowed old print, faded blues, olive greens, darker corners. The yellowed greys need WB shift (not on E-M1 II).

ricoh_cine_yellow.name: Cine Yellow
ricoh_cine_yellow.notes: Ricoh GR IV-style Cinema (Yellow): golden-amber grade, yellow-olive foliage, muted teal skies.

ricoh_cine_green.name: Cine Green
ricoh_cine_green.notes: Ricoh GR IV-style Cinema (Green): green-teal grade, teal skies, deep cyan-green foliage, lifted blacks.
